description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android Activity class 'OnboardingActivity' that manages a multi-page onboarding flow for an app, including UI setup, navigation handling, accessibility features, and page content definitions.

classes.name: OnboardingPage
classes.description: Data class representing an individual onboarding page content with title, body, and image resources.

classes.name: OnboardingPagerAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter class for binding onboarding page data to views within the ViewPager2 component.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the onboarding activity, deciding whether to display onboarding or skip to main activity.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Initializes view references by finding UI elements by ID.

methods.name: setupPager
methods.description: Configures the ViewPager2 with its adapter and page change callback.

methods.name: setupActions
methods.description: Sets up click listeners for navigation buttons.

methods.name: updateButtonsForPage
methods.description: Updates the visibility of navigation buttons based on the current page index.

methods.name: updateDots
methods.description: Dynamically updates the page indicator dots' appearance to reflect the current page.

methods.name: completeAndEnter
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed and navigates to the main activity.

methods.name: goToMain
methods.description: Starts the main activity and finishes the onboarding activity.
